JavaScript executor usage for clicking potentially hidden elements

Keyboard shortcut integration (Ctrl+R for refresh, END for scroll, PAGE_DOWN for pagination)
Polling loops with time-based timeouts for dynamic element searching
Environment-aware element selection (stage/prod vs regular locators)
Extensive logging for debugging missing elements and flow states
Coordinate-based clicking with offset calculations for precise interactions
Alpha/workaround code noted for Windows dummy printer handling
